{"predictors": [
  {"name": "Inventory Turnover", "construction": "Cost of Goods Sold divided by Inventory", "rationale": "Firms with higher inventory turnover might be managing their resources more efficiently, leading to higher profitability and thus higher stock returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Age of Firm", "construction": "Number of years since the firm's founding", "rationale": "Older established firms might have more stability and thus less risk, leading to better performance", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Customer Concentration", "construction": "Revenue from a firm's largest customer divided by total revenue", "rationale": "Firms with more customer concentration might face higher risk from loss of a key client, affecting their stock returns negatively", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Employee Turnover", "construction": "Number of employees leaving over a given period divided by the total number of employees", "rationale": "High employee turnover might indicate internal problems or lack of employee satisfaction, affecting future performance negatively", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
  {"name": "R&D Intensity", "construction": "R&D expenditure divided by Total Assets", "rationale": "Firms with higher R&D intensity might have higher growth prospects, leading to higher stock returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Tax Payment Intensity", "construction": "Tax paid divided by Pre-tax profit", "rationale": "Firms with high tax payments might be more profitable with more stable earnings, leading to higher stock returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Lease Obligation Intensity", "construction": "Lease obligations divided by Total Assets", "rationale": "Firms with higher lease obligations might face more financial constraints, negatively affecting stock returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Currency Exposure", "construction": "Foreign sales divided by Total Sales", "rationale": "Firms with higher currency exposure might face more risk due to currency fluctuations, affecting their stock returns negatively", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Litigation Risk", "construction": "Number of ongoing lawsuits divided by market capitalization", "rationale": "Firms with higher litigation risk might face more uncertainties, negatively affecting future stock returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Geographic Diversification", "construction": "Number of countries where the firm operates divided by total sales", "rationale": "Firms with higher geographic diversification might have more growth opportunities, leading to higher stock returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}
]}
